title: Renew a private health facility licence
summary: Renew your private hospital or day procedure centre licence online or at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
NSW Health regulates and licenses privately owned and operated health facilities across the state.

You can renew your private hospital or day procedure centre licence online, using your credit card.

If you don't wish to renew online, you can visit a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details

how_to_steps.text: Enter your licence and renewal number as shown on your renewal notice. (If you don't have your renewal number, select 'Don't have?' and enter your name, birth date and postcode.)
Confirm the details of your licence.
